defects.why: Front ring reads 100 Calories Per Serving; the file's own NFP and approved F-00068 v1.0 read 130. Three of the four rings are correct, so a check that binds a ring to the wrong value either misses this or fires on a correct ring. Calories is a do-not-exceed nutrient (21 CFR 101.9(g)(5)): 130 against a declared 100 is 130%, so CRITICAL.

The approved panel names F-00069 v1.2; the master row names no formula, as the live export does. Its fill weight cannot be shown to belong to the approved formula (the live export's pre-reformulation weights produced four false CRITICALs), so the net-weight check must not use it: could not evaluate, NOT_RUN, not CLEAN.
